regulated.why: Frameworks are learned by understanding what each one means for a build, then filling in a week-one checklist.

fieldlife.why: Field life is judgement about people and time, best learned from stories plus plans and trackers you fill in.

interviewrounds.why: Each round is a skill you rehearse with a timer; the loop map shows what to prepare in what order.

portfolio.why: You learn this by building: fill in the README and demo templates on your own projects.
